question: Should Signal native quote replies ship default-on with `channels.signal.replyToMode` defaulting to `all` for existing users?
rationale: The implementation is plausibly correct, but default-on channel reply quoting and new config fields are compatibility-sensitive product choices that automation should not decide for a maintainer-authored draft.

options.title: Confirm default-on quotes
options.body: Accept `replyToMode: all` as the Signal upgrade default and proceed once normal maintainer draft review is complete.

options.title: Make native quotes opt-in
options.body: Change the default to `off` or `first` and require users to opt into broader native quote behavior through config.

options.title: Hold for broader quote plan
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide how it should relate to the open inbound BodyForAgent quote-context work.

recommendation.title: Confirm default-on quotes
recommendation.body: Accept `replyToMode: all` as the Signal upgrade default and proceed once normal maintainer draft review is complete.
